main_text.p: Μελίτη ης ή nomen insula, Gr. melliflua.
Μέλχ ὁ nomen viri ἀχλιῶν, Hebr. rex meus.
Μελχισεδὲκ ὁ nomen viri sancti ἀκλιτον, Hebr. rex justitiæ.
Μεσοποταμία ας ή nomen regionis, Gr. interam-nis. in Genesi vocatur הארם פדן h.e. campus Syria, seu Syria campestris.
Μίλητον ἡ τὸ nomen urbis, Act. 20.13. Gr. rubra. coccinea.
Μηδ ἡ ὁ nomen gentile, Hebr. dimensio.
Μιτυλήνη ης ή nomen insula, Gr. μίτυλος mu-tilus.
Μιχαὴλ ὁ nomen angeli ἀρχιόν, item viri, Num. 13.14. 1. Chron. 5.13. item CHRISTI Hebr. quis sicut DEUS.
Μνάσων ὡν ὁ nomen viri, Act. 21.16.
Μολὸχ ὁ nomen idoli ἀχλιῶν, Hebr. regnans.
Μυσία ας ή nomen regionis, Gr. μύσος ἐς τὸ facinus detestandum.
Μύρρα ὧν τὸ nomen oppidi, Gr. fundens, ἀ μύρω stillo, fluo, fundo, fleo. ὀδυσσ. τ. Act. 27.5.

Μωσῆς ὁ Genit. Μωσέως Μωυσέως. Dat. Μωσῇ Μωυσεῖ. Acc. Μωσέα ἐν Μωσέα. Voc. Μωσῆ, nomen prophetæ, Ægyptiacum ex mo aqua, ἐν ὕφες servatus. q. d. ex aqua servatus Joseph. antiq. Jud. lib.2. c.5. ἐν 9. vel מֹשֶׁה pro מֹשֶׁה extractus (ex aquis) Exod.2.10.
Note: marginal entries at the right edge (Nαασων, Nαζιρ, Ναζαρ, Νασαμ, Νασιρ, Νασιλ, Νεκαφ, Νιγρ, Νιτ, Νικανωρ, Νικοδημος, Νικολαος, Νινευη) are cropped and only partly legible.

page.notes: The right-hand margin is cropped and the Greek and Hebrew entries there are only partly legible; their transcription is approximate and omitted where unreadable. Some Hebrew and Greek words in the main text are approximate.
